sentences.text:
THE DRUGS CONTROLLER  ASSAM  HENGRABARI  GUWAHATI-3 For the applicant : Mr. K.N. Choudhury, Sr. Advocate  Mr. D.J. Das, Advocate For the respondents : Mr. D. Upamanyu,
S.C., Health & Family Welfare Deptt.
-BEFORE- HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. ASHUTOSH KUMAR HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN DEV CHOUDHURY 17-11-2025 (Ashutosh Kumar, C.J.)

This Interlocutory Application has been filed by the applicant/appellant seeking condonation of delay of 39 days in preferring the connected appeal against the order dated 27.08.2025 Page No.# 3/3 passed by a learned Single Judge of this Court in WP(C) No.2135/2025 and other connected cases.
Learned counsel for the respondents offers no objection to such a prayer.
We have gone through the reasons provided in the application seeking condonation of delay.
Finding it to be good reasons, we condone the delay.
The Interlocutory Application stands allowed and disposed off.

The Registry to process the appeal and list the same on 19.01.2026 under the appropriate heading.
